under.text: Available in 1/4 in. (6.4 mm) and 3/8 in. (9.5 mm) thicknesses, USG Sheetrock® Brand Gypsum Panels feature a noncombustible gypsum core that is encased in 100% recycled face and back papers that form a high strength composite design. The face paper is folded around the long edges to reinforce and protect the core, and the ends are cut square and even. The long edges of the panels are tapered, allowing joints to be reinforced and concealed with USG Sheetrock® Brand joint treatment systems.
Commercial or residential applications where 1/4 in. (6.4 mm) or 3/8 in. (9.5 mm) panels are desired
